arxiv-2109-02709.title: Integral transforms related to Nevanlinna-Pick functions from an analytic, probabilistic and free-probability point of view
arxiv-2109-02709.creator: Wissem Jedidi, Zbigniew J. Jurek and Nuha Taymani ∗
arxiv-2109-02709.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Wissem Jedidi, Zbigniew J. Jurek and Nuha Taymani ∗. We establish a new connection between the class of Nevanlinna-Pick functions and the one of the exponents associated to spectrally negative Lévy processes. As a consequence, we compute the characteristics related to some hyperbolic functions and we show a property of temporal complete monotonicity, similar to the one obtained via the Lamperti transformation by Bertoin & Yor ( On subordinators, self-similar Markov processes and some factorizations of the exponential variable , Elect.

arxiv-2303-16537.title: LMExplainer: Grounding Knowledge and Explaining Language Models
arxiv-2303-16537.creator: Zichen Chen, Jianda Chen, Yuanyuan Chen, Han Yu, Ambuj Singh, Misha Sra
arxiv-2303-16537.description: Abstract Language models (LMs) like GPT-4 are important in AI applications, but their opaque decision-making process reduces user trust, especially in safety-critical areas. We introduce LMExplainer , a novel knowledge-grounded explainer that clarifies the reasoning process of LMs through intuitive, human-understandable explanations.

arxiv-2402-14256.title: Distributed Partial Quantum Consensus of Qubit Networks with Connected Topologies
arxiv-2402-14256.creator: Xin Jin, Zhu Cao, Yang Tang, Jürgen Kurths
arxiv-2402-14256.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the partial quantum consensus problem of a qubit network in a distributed view. The local quantum operation is designed based on the Hamiltonian by using the local information of each quantum system in a network of qubits. arxiv-2409-10978.title: Edge-based Denoising Image Compression
arxiv-2409-10978.creator: Ryugo Morita 1 3 , Hitoshi Nishimura 2 , Ko Watanabe 3 , Andreas Dengel 3 , Jinjia Zhou 1
arxiv-2409-10978.description: Abstract In recent years, deep learning-based image compression, particularly through generative models, has emerged as a pivotal area of research. Despite significant advancements, challenges such as diminished sharpness and quality in reconstructed images, learning inefficiencies due to mode collapse, and data loss during transmission persist.

arxiv-2412-06726.title: ICtoken: An NFT for Hardware IP Protection
arxiv-2412-06726.creator: Shashank Balla, Yiming Zhao, Farinaz Koushanfar
arxiv-2412-06726.description: Abstract . Protecting integrated circuits (ICs) from piracy and theft throughout their lifecycle is a persistent and complex challenge. In order to safeguard against illicit piracy attacks, this work proposes a novel framework utilizing Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) called ICtokens, uniquely linked to their corresponding physical ICs.

arxiv-2505-06662.title: Doping Topological Dirac Semimetal with magnetic impurities: electronic structure of Mn-doped Cd 3 As 2
arxiv-2505-06662.creator: H. Ness, I. Leahy, A. Rice, D. Pashov, K. Alberi, M. van Schilfgaarde
arxiv-2505-06662.description: Abstract The prospect of transforming a Dirac topological semimetal (TSM) into a Weyl TSM phase, following doping by magnetic impurities, is central to TSM applications. The magnetic field from polarized d d levels of magnetic impurities produces a field with a sharp local structure.

arxiv-2508-00179.title: Eccentricity signatures in LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA’s BNS and NSBH binaries
arxiv-2508-00179.creator: Keisi Kacanja 1, Kanchan Soni 1, Alexander H. Nitz 1
arxiv-2508-00179.description: Abstract Measurement of the eccentricity of low-mass binary systems through gravitational waves is crucial to distinguish between various formation channels. However, detecting eccentricity in these systems has been challenging due to the lack of accurate eccentric waveform models and the high computational cost associated with Bayesian inferences for systems with low-mass objects.

arxiv-2508-07765.title: Isomorphism of almost locally compact Polish metric structures
arxiv-2508-07765.creator: Maciej Malicki
arxiv-2508-07765.description: Abstract . A topological space is almost locally compact if it contains a dense locally compact subspace. We generalize a result from [ 6 ] , showing that isomorphism on Borel classes of almost locally compact Polish metric structures is always classifiable by countable structures.

arxiv-2601-00256.title: Equivariant Cohomology, BRST Quantization, and Analytic Localization: A Unified Framework
arxiv-2601-00256.creator: Lixin Xu
arxiv-2601-00256.description: Abstract This paper provides a detailed exposition of the two main models for equivariant cohomology—the Cartan and Weil models—and their explicit isomorphism via the Kalkman (Mathai–Quillen) transformation. We then connect this framework to the BRST quantization of gauge theories, showing how the BRST complex can be identified with the Cartan model.

europmc-pmc5624513.description: While single-cell gene expression experiments present new challenges for data processing, the cell-to-cell variability observed also reveals statistical relationships that can be used by information theory. Here, we use multivariate information theory to explore the statistical...

pmc-10675293.title: Evidence of Reliable Gastro-Resistance of Novel Enteric Ready-to-Fill Capsules Simplifying Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
pmc-10675293.creator: Jesús Alberto Afonso Urich, Anna Fedorko, Bettina Hölzer, Johannes Khinast
pmc-10675293.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Developing delayed-release formulations for acid-sensitive actives can be a costly and time-consuming process. However, ready-to-fill functional capsules, such as EUDRACAP® can significantly mitigate these challenges. The in vitro performance of EUDRACAP® enteric was evaluated in two typical delayed-release scenarios: for diclofenac (a drug that can cause irritation to gastric mucosa), and for omeprazole (a drug susceptible to degradation due to the acidity of gastric fluid).

pmc-11404214.title: Investigating the relationship between spermogram parameters and sexual desire in infertile men: a cross-sectional study from a tertiary centre in Iran
pmc-11404214.creator: Naser Amirjannati, Hamed Akhavizadegan, Arash Mohazzab, Behzad Ghorbani, Razieh Lotfi, Manizheh Fathalian
pmc-11404214.description: AbstractBackgroundMale factor infertility can affect spermatogenesis, sexual desire, and thus the quality of life of couples. The present study was conducted to investigate the relationship between spermogram parameters, and the score of sexual desire in infertile men.MethodsThis cross-sectional study was conducted on 315 infertile men referred to the Avicenna Infertility Center of Tehran (March 2022 to March 2023).

pmc-11713996.title: Acculturation scales in Dementia in US Latinos/Hispanics: A Systematic Review
pmc-11713996.creator: Alicia Goytizolo, Monica Rosselli
pmc-11713996.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAcculturation is a relevant variable in the assessment of dementia. Little is known about the type of acculturation scales and the frequency in which they are used in dementia research among Latinos/Hispanics in the US. The purpose of this paper was to conduct a systematic review of published studies that investigated the use of acculturation measures toward Latinos and Hispanics who are diagnosed with dementia.MethodsDatabases were searched using four key search terms: dementia, acculturation scale, Latinos, and Hispanics.

pmc-12465050.title: Selenium nanoparticles alleviate cobalt toxicity in artificial joint metal prostheses by inhibiting ferroptosis through activation of the PRDX6/GPX4 pathway
pmc-12465050.creator: Pengcheng Xu, Fan Liu, Su Jiang, Baisheng Cai, Cong Ye, Yiming Sun, Yaping Wang, Jining Shen, Huan Zhou, Yake Liu
pmc-12465050.description: The long-term implantation of metallic joint prostheses results in the release of cobalt nanoparticles (CoNPs), leading to local and even systemic toxic reactions that pose risks to patient health. Previous studies have suggested that CoNPs-induced cytotoxicity may be associated with excessive oxidative stress and ferroptosis.

pmc-12615266.title: Ultrack: pushing the limits of cell tracking across biological scales
pmc-12615266.creator: Jordão Bragantini, Ilan Theodoro, Xiang Zhao, Teun APM Huijben, Eduardo Hirata-Miyasaki, Shruthi VijayKumar, Akilandeswari Balasubramanian, Tiger Lao, Richa Agrawal, Sheng Xiao, Jan Lammerding, Shalin Mehta, Alexandre X Falcão, Adrian Jacobo, Merlin Lange, Loïc A Royer
pmc-12615266.description: Tracking live cells across two-dimensional, three-dimensional (3D) and multichannel time-lapse recordings is crucial for understanding tissue-scale biological processes. Despite advancements in imaging technology, accurately tracking cells remains challenging, particularly in complex and crowded tissues where cell segmentation is often ambiguous.

pmc-12626109.title: Building the Iowa Data Drive: a participatory approach to developing early childhood indicators for state and local policymaking
pmc-12626109.creator: Heather Rouse, Sharon Zanti, Hannah Kim, Cassandra Dorius, Todd Abraham, Giorgi Chighladze
pmc-12626109.description: IntroductionPublic service leaders face increasing challenges using data effectively due to program silos, limited resources, and the increasing complexity of data. To address these challenges, Iowa’s Integrated Data System for Decision-Making (I2D2) partnered with state and local leaders in early childhood to curate key indicators and develop population-level data tools and training to promote policy and practice improvements.

pmc-13002870.title: Evaluating the potential of acupuncture for Alzheimer’s disease treatment: A meta-analysis and systematic review of mouse model studies
pmc-13002870.creator: Mohan Yang, Liqi Tong, Zhiling Guo, Zhiqun Tan, Todd C. Holmes, Zhaoxia Yu, Xiangmin Xu
pmc-13002870.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Acupuncture is an ancient practice that was developed within the framework of traditional Chinese medicine. While acupuncture has been recently proposed as a therapy for Alzheimer’s disease (AD), acupuncture effects are not well understood in terms of neural mechanisms. Here, we review and examine the studies that used AD mouse models and analyze the experiments where researchers administered electroacupuncture (EA) to AD mice to assess the potential therapeutic impact of acupuncture on disease pathology and cognitive function in controlled laboratory settings.

pmc-13145946.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A347 SOCIOECONOMIC STATUS AS RISK FACTOR FOR STROKE AMONG WOMEN AND MEN IN THE UK BIOBANK
pmc-13145946.creator: Yijie Gao, Linan Chen, Rebecca Kelly, Sanne Peters, Cheryl Carcel, Craig Anderson, Mark Woodward, Xia Wang, Katie Harris
pmc-13145946.description: Background and aimsThe association of socioeconomic status (SES) with stroke and its subtypes are understudied in women and men. The aim of this study was to quantify sex differences in the associations between different SES indicators with stroke, and determine if the association of common risk factors with stroke differs by SES.

pmc-13301438.title: Detection of corona mortis during femoral vein puncture for electrophysiology procedures using doppler ultrasound
pmc-13301438.creator: K Kassa, R Pap
pmc-13301438.description: BackgroundThe corona mortis is an anatomical variant connecting the external iliac and obturator arterial networks. Its clinical relevance is well established in trauma and surgical settings, as inadvertent injury can result in significant, and sometimes occult haemorrhage. Anatomical, surgical, and angiographic studies estimate its incidence at 20–30%, yet its visualisation by ultrasound (US) has not been systematically assessed.

pmc-13315167.title: PCIS1 is an essential factor in mitochondrial RNA splicing and complex I biogenesis, with distinct effects in null and downregulated mutants
pmc-13315167.creator: Ella Kobaivanov, Brody Frink, Mizuki Takenaka, Oren Ostersetzer-Biran
pmc-13315167.description: Key messagePCIS1 is indispensable for plant mitochondria NAD4 and NAD7 gene expression. Null mutants abolish CI assembly and arrest embryogenesis, whereas knockouts retain partial splicing, revealing a genetic functional mt-RNA metabolism threshold.AbstractPlant mitochondrial biogenesis relies on the splicing of numerous group II introns, primarily in genes encoding complex I (CI) subunits, which require multiple nuclear-encoded cofactors.

pmc-13401383.title: Eculizumab-Induced Acute Heart Failure Decompensation in a Patient with Clinically Suspected Complement-Mediated Thrombotic Microangiopathy: A Case Report
pmc-13401383.creator: Jiayang Huang, Tongtian Ni, Hong Liu, Yi Yao, Mengjiao Li, Bing Zhao, Ke Zhang, Wangsheng Li, Enqiang Mao, Yihui Wang, Juan He
pmc-13401383.description: Eculizumab is a highly effective and generally safe therapy for atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS), a rare subtype of thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA). This report presents a case of recurrent episodes of acute decompensated heart failure temporally related to its administration, a possible adverse effect that is exceedingly rare and poorly documented in the literature.

pmc-13541641.title: Live-attenuated vaccines of human respiratory syncytial virus for infants and young children: Progress and prospects of an old yet promising platform
pmc-13541641.creator: Jiemei Yu, Yuanhui Fu, Yanpeng Zheng, Xianglei Peng, Jinsheng He
pmc-13541641.description: Highlights•No human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine has achieved regulatory approval for RSV-seronegative children aged 6 months to 5 years.•Reverse genetics has proven instrumental in balancing the attenuation and immunogenicity of RSV live-attenuated vaccines (LAVs).•RSV LAVs show no evidence of VAERD during clinical evaluation in RSV-seronegative pediatric cohorts.

uslaw-usc-t21-s2301.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t21-s2301.description: United States Code, Title 21 (Food And Drugs); Chapter 28 (Sanctions With Respect To Foreign Traffickers Of Illicit Synthetic Opioids). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It is the sense of Congress that— (1) the United States should apply economic and other financial sanctions to foreign traffickers of illicit opioids to protect the national security, foreign policy, and economy of the United States.
